description: Deletes the diagnostic log files of WebinarIgnition. Take it when you want a clean slate before you reproduce a problem: "Clear the logs, then I do it once more and we look." It needs the session and a clear yes from you. With a webinar id only that campaign's logs go, without one the logs of every campaign on the site are cleared, so say which of the two it is. The logs cannot be restored. The campaign, its registrants and its emails are not touched. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: clear logs, delete logs, log files, clean slate, error logs

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said which logs may be cleared.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: Clear only this campaign's logs. Leave it out to clear the logs of every campaign on the site.

name: wi_delete_webinar_logs
title: Delete the WebinarIgnition log files
